description: As CRM Administrator for an aerospace manufacturing company, a botched data migration from a legacy ERP system has introduced duplicate account records into SuiteCRM. Several real-world companies now appear under multiple slightly different names — abbreviations, 'The' prefix, or 'Inc.' versus 'Co.' variations. Each duplicate may have its own contacts, opportunities, and cases that properly belong to the canonical (original) account record. Identify all duplicate accounts, reassign every related contact, opportunity, and case from the duplicates to the correct canonical account, then delete the duplicate account records. Exercise extreme care: some company names may appear similar but represent genuinely different organizations. Do not merge accounts that are actually distinct companies.
